comment: Two params, the run and reset buttons, are declared in the code but no widget is placed for either, so neither can be clicked and neither gets a line. The grid, the play-position strip, the measure strip and the pattern panel are all drawn inside custom widgets with no ParamWidget of their own, so they cannot be clicked for help either; they are covered by Note lines. The PTRN output is not a copy of the PTRN input, as the README says the left outputs are, but the currently selected pattern expressed as a pitch.
